Are you passionate about electronics and eager to apply your knowledge to real-world engineering challenges? Join Honeywell's Water Metering Centre of Excellence in Luton and kick-start your career with a global leader in smart utility metering technology.
As a Graduate Electronics Engineer, you'll gain hands-on experience working on products that are deployed worldwide, helping utilities improve the way water is measured and managed. You'll be exposed to innovative technologies including low-power electronics, ultrasonic sensing, inductive measurement techniques, IoT connectivity, and LTE communications. This is an exciting opportunity to learn from experienced engineers, contribute to meaningful projects, and develop a broad understanding of the entire product lifecycle.
Reporting to the Electronic Development Manager, you'll work across both new product development and sustaining engineering, giving you exceptional exposure to how cutting-edge products are designed, tested, launched, and continuously improved.
Collaborate with experienced engineers to develop and test next-generation smart metering products and communication technologies.
Investigate new technologies, conduct validation testing, and help identify and resolve technical issues.
Support low-power electronic design, component selection, and product improvement initiatives.
Participate in technical reviews, prepare engineering reports, and contribute to problem-solving activities.
Provide production support and develop Python-based tools to improve testing and engineering efficiency.
Assist with engineering change management, product enhancements, component lifecycle management, and validation of design updates.
A degree in Electronics, Physics, or a related engineering discipline.
Practical experience using laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, and soldering equipment.
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
A hands-on mindset and genuine enthusiasm for electronics and technology.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a curiosity for understanding how things work.
Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively within a team.
Why Join Honeywell?
Gain valuable experience with a world-leading engineering and technology company.
Work on products used by customers across the globe.
Learn from experienced engineers in a collaborative and supportive environment.
Develop technical skills across product development, testing, manufacturing support, and innovation.
Build a strong foundation for a successful career in electronics engineering.
We Offer
At Honeywell, we recognise that a great career is about more than your salary. Our UK benefits are designed to support your financial wellbeing, health, family and life outside work , while helping you plan for the future.
Depending on eligibility, our benefits include:
Competitive pay and pension: A competitive salary and a defined contribution pension plan, with employer contributions to help you save for the future.
Private healthcare: Access to private medical treatment, alongside virtual GP consultations, mental health support, physiotherapy and specialist medical second opinions.
Employee share opportunities: The opportunity to become a Honeywell shareholder through our Employee Share Purchase Plan.
Support when you are unwell: Company sick pay for eligible employees, together with income protection to provide additional financial support during qualifying long-term illness or disability.
Life assurance: Financial protection for your loved ones, with the level of cover determined by plan eligibility.
Family-friendly benefits: Enhanced maternity, adoption and paternity benefits for eligible employees, as well as shared parental leave arrangements.
Wellbeing support: Free, confidential assistance for employees and their families across everyday, personal, family, legal and financial matters.
Everyday savings: Access to employee discounts, cashback and savings across shopping, travel, dining, entertainment and other everyday purchases, together with negotiated corporate rates with selected global suppliers.
Protection when travelling for work: Worldwide accident protection for eligible company business travel.
Recognition and development: Employee recognition and referral programmes, global employee networks and opportunities to develop your career internationally.
Employees may also have access to a range of voluntary benefits , including a medical cash plan, dental insurance, tax-efficient Cycle to Work arrangements, savings and investment options, and additional personal and family protection benefits.
Additional benefits may be available depending on the role and eligibility, including annual or sales incentive plans, a company car or cash allowance, flexible or hybrid working arrangements, and equity awards .
Benefits are subject to eligibility and the applicable Honeywell plan and policy terms. Benefit offerings may be amended from time to time.

Legal Intern - PA&T Commercial - Europe (Process Automation and Technologies )
Location: Bracknell, hybrid (3+2)
Duration: 12 months, Full-time, starting January 2027
Honeywell is a global automation leader serving building, industrial, and process customers. Our PA&T business provides automation platforms, process technologies, and software to energy, chemical, refining, manufacturing, and other process industries across Europe.
It is a hands-on role with real matters and direct contact with the business.
The Legal Intern will support the PA&T business in Europe on a broad range of commercial legal matters. The role will provide exposure to commercial transactions, contracting and other day-to-day legal support across PA&T.
From time to time, the intern may also be required to support legal matters for other Honeywell business units in Europe, depending on business needs and priorities.
Do a first review of customer and supplier contracts for PA&T (sales agreements, terms and conditions, service agreements, purchase orders) against Honeywell standards and playbooks.
Flag deviations on key risk terms, such as limitation of liability, indemnities, warranties, IP, and payment terms.
Draft standard documents and amendments, and prepare redlines for senior lawyers’ review.
Support tender and bid reviews, for PA&T projects, including public procurement documentation.
Help with compliance screenings on transactions, including liaising with Export Control, Sanctions, And Anti-Corruption functions.
Keep contract tracker and repository up to date, and prepare matter and contract summaries for sales and commercial teams.
Help with legal team projects, including project management work for M&A transactions and other corporate initiatives, training materials, and process improvements.
Required :
Recent law graduate (2026).
Strong interest in commercial contracts and corporate law.
Fluent in English, written and spoken.
Careful, organized, and able to handle several matters at once.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook, and AI tools.
Preferred :
Strong grades in contract law, company law, or international trade.
One or more additional European languages, such as German, French, Italian, Dutch, Spanish, Polish.
Earlier internship experience in a law firm or in-house legal team.
Comfort using legal technology and AI tools for drafting and research.
What You'll gain:
Direct exposure to the commercial and corporate work of a global industrial business.
Mentoring from experienced in-house lawyers.
Work with business, finance, tax, and compliance teams across Europe.

161883.text:
At Honeywell Technologies, you can work on technology that helps make the world safer, smarter and more efficient. We are a global automation company helping customers run critical operations safely, reliably and efficiently, and we are moving from automation toward autonomy by combining AI, controls, connected data and domain expertise.
Are you interested in AI, Machine Learning or Generative AI, and looking for an opportunity to develop and grow in a global company? We are looking for motivated students to join our EMEA Innovation Hub in Dublin, Ireland. The hub delivers new AI capabilities into the Honeywell Forge product portfolio, from machine learning and time-series analytics to LLM-based and agentic AI, and develops them into industry-grade services deployed globally in mission-critical environments. Over the summer, you will apply AI to real-world challenges such as energy efficiency, sustainability and net-zero commitments.
Build, test and evaluate AI/ML and Generative AI solutions, including LLM-based and agentic applications, for Honeywell Forge products.
Work with industrial IoT and time-series data to develop algorithms that improve energy efficiency, comfort, asset performance and predictive maintenance.
Write high-quality Python code using modern engineering practices such as version control, testing, code review and CI/CD.
Collaborate with an international team of AI, ML and data engineers and product owners to turn business requirements into working prototypes.
Research emerging AI techniques, document your results and present progress to team leadership and stakeholders.
Currently pursuing a master’s degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, Software Engineering or a related field.
Strong Python programming skills, with experience using libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow.
Completed modules or projects in areas such as machine learning, deep learning, time-series analytics, NLP or Generative AI.
Exposure to LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG or agent frameworks (e.g. LangChain/LangGraph), Git and cloud platforms such as Azure or GCP is a strong plus.
Curious, creative and collaborative, with strong problem-solving skills and good written and spoken English.
We Offer:
Hands-on work on industry-first AI projects that contribute to products used by some of the world’s biggest brands.
Mentoring from experienced AI engineers and researchers in our Dublin EMEA Innovation Hub.
Training on software development methodologies and best practices in Python, data science and AI engineering.
Access to all required IT equipment, cloud services and AI platforms for your projects.
A collaborative, inclusive culture that values continuous learning, diverse perspectives and celebrating achievement.
